h: 这是 ConsistencyLoRA 的工作流程。实际上这只是一个基本的 Wan2.2 I2V 工作流程。您输入的图像是您要保持一致的对象。例如，汽车为 CarConsistency ，一件衣服为 ClothingConsistency 。在使用 LoRA 之前，请务必阅读型号描述页面中的红线，确保以正确的方式使用它。

o.en: This is the WorkFlow for ConsistencyLoRAs. It is a just basic Wan2.2 I2V workflow actually. The image you input is the object you want to keep consistent. For example, a car for the CarConsistency , a clothing for the ClothingConsistency. And before you using the LoRA, make sure you read the red lines in the model description page , make sure you use it in the right way.
